arguments.text: Implemented state-transition evaluation: resolve the exact from>to key from the supplied policy; absent edge returns blocked; a present role requirement is checked before retry validation; supplied attempts must have exact int type (excluding bool), be nonnegative, and be below an integer retry_limit; successes return the requested to value. Inputs remain unchanged and outputs contain exactly ok/value/reason.

Verified current report.json equals evaluating every requests.json item against policy.json; both current results succeed. Boundary checks covered missing edges, permission precedence over invalid retries, attempts at -1/0/limit-1/limit, bool/float/string/null attempts, retry_limit zero, exact output fields, schema types, and input immutability.

Unresolved contract limits: behavior for malformed non-mapping request/policy/edges/edge values is unspecified; retry_limit validity when no attempts is supplied is not required by observed contract. Implementation intentionally validates retries only when attempts is present.
